observations.why: Imperative directive commanding erasure of knowledge enacts authority-ranking: the speaker issues a binding instruction to a subordinate recipient.
Second imperative command to purge information continues the authority-ranking pattern: hierarchical instruction demanding compliance.

mints.title: command to forget or remove knowledge
mints.frame: Is the speaker issuing a binding instruction to eliminate held knowledge, asserting authority over what the recipient may retain?
